title: Detail charts and calendar heatmap without a chart library
findings_note: MainScreen.kt:395-416 (14 rows of LinearProgressIndicator with ISO dates); TrackerAnalytics.buildTrend
boundary: **Not in this slice:** zoom or pan, multi-tracker comparison, or any third-party chart dependency.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The "Recent trend" section is 14 stacked progress bars labeled `2026-04-21` and takes about a full screen.
- MEASURE trackers (weight, sleep) need a line chart to be useful.
- There's no month view showing hits and misses, which is the main motivation signal for streaks.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- TrackerAnalytics.kt (add `buildMonth`, extend trend window)
- TrackerModels.kt
- new `ui/charts/BarChart.kt`, `ui/charts/LineChart.kt`, `ui/charts/CalendarHeatmap.kt`
- MainScreen.kt detail section

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM:
- `buildMonth marks met days and padding for first weekday`, which respects `WeekFields.of(locale)`
- `trend for MEASURE excludes days without entries` (null rather than 0, so lines don't dive to zero)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Analytics:
   - Make `TrendPoint.value: Double?`. Use null for MEASURE days with no entry; COUNT and YES_NO days default to 0.
   - Add `buildMonth(bundle, yearMonth, today): List<DayCell(date, value, met, isFuture)>`.
   - Make the window 30 days for bars and lines.
2. `BarChart` (COUNT/YES_NO): use a Compose `Canvas` with one bar per day in primary color, and an outline color when the target isn't met. Draw a dashed target line, and label only the first, middle, and last dates with a short localized format.
3. `LineChart` (MEASURE): use a Canvas path that skips nulls, with dots, min and max labels, and the unit.
4. `CalendarHeatmap`: a 7-column month grid. Fill met days with primary, partial days at 40% alpha, and missed past days with outline only; future days are blank. Add month back/forward arrows. Tapping a day opens the entry dialog prefilled with that date, or the existing entry if there's one.
5. Accessibility: every chart has `Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = "Last 30 days: 22 of 30 days met target, average 6.2 glasses" }`. Calendar cells are individually focusable, with labels like "April 3, target met".
6. Use theme colors only (S11). Gold/tertiary is for streak highlights.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The unit tests pass.
- Manual: COUNT shows bars and a target line, and MEASURE shows a gapped line.
- Calendar tap-to-log works.
- TalkBack reads the chart summaries.
